recipe: static void trial_sound_trace_pcm(spu_context* ctx, const char* stage, unsigned ptr, unsigned bytes, unsigned count)
fprintf(stderr, "[sound-pcm] %s count=%u ptr=%X bytes=%u peak=%g\n", stage, count, ptr, bytes, peak);

{ static unsigned n; if(n++%300==0) { u128 cfg=spu_ls_read128(ctx,0x18BB0); u128 a=spu_ls_read128(ctx,cfg._u32[0]); u128 b=spu_ls_read128(ctx,cfg._u32[0]+32); if(frontier_audio_trace_enabled()) fprintf(stderr,"[spu-list] ptr=%X first=%08X cfg=%X words=%08X/%08X/%08X/%08X tail=%08X/%08X\n",ctx->gpr[28]._u32[0],ctx->gpr[5]._u32[0],cfg._u32[0],a._u32[0],a._u32[1],a._u32[2],a._u32[3],b._u32[0],b._u32[1]); } }
{ static unsigned n; u128 p = spu_ls_read128(ctx, 0x18BD0); trial_sound_trace_pcm(ctx, "mix", p._u32[0], 8192, ++n); }
{ static unsigned n; trial_sound_trace_pcm(ctx, "output", ctx->gpr[3]._u32[0], ctx->gpr[5]._u32[0] <= 8192 ? ctx->gpr[5]._u32[0] : 8192, ++n); }
